title: Sneaky Peeker
summary: Someone who watches or guesses to learn your password.
example: A stranger in a game chat says: "What was your first pet? Mine was Biscuit!" to guess your security answer.
howToSpot: Questions about pets, schools or birthdays can be clues to your password.
whatToDo: Keep those answers private. Use long passwords that are not about you.
